item.title: Himeyuri Peace Museum Guide: Access & What to Know
item.description: The Himeyuri Peace Memorial Museum in Itoman, in southern Okinawa, tells one of the most moving stories of the Battle of Okinawa (1945). The “Himeyuri” were a group of around 200 teenage schoolgirls and their teachers mobilised as a student nursing corps; most lost their lives in the final weeks of the battle. The museum and adjacent monument, built where many died, preserve their testimonies, photographs and belongings as a powerful plea for peace.
